sentences.english: The husband has a large field.
The husband carries water to the field.
The small dog guards the field.
The wife prepares good food.
The wife buys new wine.
The small son sees the dog.
The daughter hears the small bird.
The family has much food.
The husband lifts a beautiful flower.
The wife sees the beautiful flower.
The wife praises the good husband.
The husband loves the faithful wife.
The husband teaches the wise son.
The husband sees the sun.
The wife sees the stars.

sentences.latin: Vir ad urbem novam cum amīcō suō iter facit.
sentences.english: The husband makes a journey to the new city with his own friend.

sentences.latin: Uxor dē virō suō fortī cōgitat.
sentences.english: The wife thinks about her own brave husband.

sentences.latin: In templō deō dōnum ab uxōre datur.
sentences.english: In the temple, a gift is given to the god by the wife.

sentences.latin: Vir per silvam altam equō vehitur.
sentences.english: The husband is carried through the deep forest on horseback.
The husband makes for the high mountain.
The husband sees the great new city.

sentences.latin: Vir in urbe dōna multa emit.
sentences.english: The husband buys many gifts in the city.

sentences.latin: Vir uxōrī suae librum novum emit.
sentences.english: The husband buys his own wife a new book.

sentences.latin: Vir amīcō suō dōnum parvum dat.
sentences.english: The husband gives his own friend a small gift.
The husband sees great danger.
The husband calls the god with a loud voice.

sentences.latin: Deus fidēlem virum ā perīculō servat.
sentences.english: The god saves the faithful husband from danger.

sentences.latin: Uxor in templō bonum deum laudat.
sentences.english: The wife praises the good god in the temple.
The friend writes good words to the wife.
The happy wife sees the friend's words.

sentences.latin: Vir ad familiam suam iter facit.
sentences.english: The husband makes a journey to his own family.
The happy wife sees her own husband.

sentences.latin: Uxōrī ā virō dōnum novum datur.
sentences.english: A new gift is given to the wife by the husband.
The wife praises her own brave husband.

sentences.latin: Vir et uxor in templō deō dōnum dant.
sentences.english: The husband and wife give the god a gift in the temple.

sentences.latin: Mīles fortis ā rēge sapientī ad bellum longum et grave mittitur.
sentences.english: The brave soldier is sent to the long and serious war by the wise king.

sentences.latin: Uxor mīlitis magnō et gravī perīculō opprimitur.
sentences.english: The soldier's wife is overwhelmed by great and serious danger.

sentences.latin: Oppidum rēgis ā mīlitibus fortibus et fidēlibus custōdītur.
sentences.english: The king's town is guarded by the brave and faithful soldiers.

sentences.latin: Uxor deum immortālem prō virō suō fortī quaerit.
sentences.english: The wife seeks the immortal god on behalf of her own brave husband.

sentences.latin: Itaque uxor fēlīx virum suum fortem et fidēlem videt.
sentences.english: And so the happy wife sees her own brave and faithful husband.
